messages:
alex: Hey @maria @emily — customer ACME (enterprise) opened a compliance request: they want an ISO 27001 mapping for data retention, audit logs, and our KMS/HSM usage. They also reported an API error that looks like it may have dropped audit entries: `audit_write_failed`. Ticket #12345. Can security advise what artifacts we should provide and any repro steps?

samir: looping in @maria. quick ask — is this hosted or dedicated for ACME? also need to know if they use customer-managed keys.

alex: hosted (hosted API), using our managed KMS. Error window: 2024-10-10T14:21:03Z -> 2024-10-10T14:25:10Z. attaching their sample log snippet below.

alex: ```
2024-10-10T14:21:03Z ERROR api-handler audit_write_failed request_id=3b9f7a X-tenant=acme-corp status=500 msg="write timeout to audit-store"
2024-10-10T14:21:03Z INFO api-handler forward_request request_id=3b9f7a route=/v1/generate
2024-10-10T14:21:05Z ERROR audit-writer write_attempt=1 request_id=3b9f7a err="connection reset by peer"
```

maria: Got it. To respond to ISO 27001 questions and show the audit trail, we should supply: 1) exported audit logs (JSON) for the affected time window, 2) KMS key usage logs / key rotation history, 3) our data retention policy (hosted default + any contract overrides), 4) a control-mapping matrix linking our features to ISO controls (eg A.12.4 logging, A.10.1 cryptographic controls, A.8.2 asset handling). I can draft a minimal mapping doc.

emily: I can produce the mapping + risk notes. Typical controls customers ask for: A.6, A.8, A.9, A.10, A.12, A.15, A.18. Note: hosted retention default is 90 days unless enterprise contract states otherwise. Also need to be explicit about where audit logs are stored (encrypted at rest in S3-like store) and access controls.

samir: For repro/correlation, ask customer to repro with a stable X-Request-ID header so we can tie their request to our internal traces. Example: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-ID: acme-req-0001" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d "{\"prompt\":\"test\"}"``` That helps us confirm whether audit writes fail on our side.

security-bot: Incident created INC-2024-987 and assigned to @maria. Related ticket: #12345.

maria: I'll pull the audit export for that window and the KMS usage logs. Quick note: our managed KMS is HSM-backed by the cloud provider; we do not hold raw key material. I'll attach provider HSM attestation and key rotation logs to the artifact bundle.

alex: Perfect. I'll ask ACME to repro with X-Request-ID and send us the raw request/response pair. Also will confirm any contractual retention overrides. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
